visual_action: A slideshow of two still images of Donald Trump. In the first, he is seated and hunched forward in a chair, with what appears to be farm equipment and hay bales in the background. In the second, he is standing outdoors on a lawn in front of several microphones, with a helicopter and the Washington Monument in the background, holding one hand up.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: His face appears in both photos in the video, and the on-screen text refers to "trump's posture".

cast.name: Rowley Family Chiropractic
cast.evidence: The on-screen text mentions an appointment at "rowley family chiropractic!"

on_screen_text.text: can't wait for trump's posture to be fixed after his July 3rd appointment at rowley family chiropractic!

audio_music: A gentle, pensive acoustic guitar track ('someday i'll get it' by Alek Olsen) plays throughout the video. The melancholic tone creates an ironic contrast with the mocking on-screen text.
central_claim: Donald Trump has poor posture, implying he is physically frail or unfit.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump's physical appearance and make viewers see him as old or weak.
